tools.name: load_tool
tools.description: Lazy tools are not in your tool list. With no arguments, list them (name and one-line summary). With names, describe lazy tools: each one's name, id, description and inputSchema. With run and arguments, run one lazy tool by its exact name or mcp:<server>:<tool>; arguments are its arguments as its inputSchema says. A lazy tool is never called by its own name: a direct call is refused. names and run cannot be combined.

names.description: Describe lazy tools: their tool names or tools.lazy-style patterns, in one call: a tool name, mcp:<server>:<tool>, mcp:<server>:* or *. Returns each tool's name, id, description and inputSchema. Omit names and run to list the lazy tools. The total of matched tools is limited by the profile's tools.lazy_load_max. Not together with run.

run.description: Run one lazy tool: its exact tool name or mcp:<server>:<tool>, no pattern. Give its arguments in arguments, as its inputSchema says (see names). Not together with names.

arguments.description: The arguments of the tool named in run. Defaults to {}. Used only with run.
